item.title: 在大数据和人工智能时代：我们还需要化学键吗？
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mohammed Al-Fahdi, Aakash Naik, Katharina Ueltzen, Luc Walterbos, Tom Demeyere, Philipp Benner 等7位作者
化学键合是化学使材料结构、稳定性、性能和反应性合理化的语言。与此同时，现代深度学习模型使用主要基于组成和结构信息的表示来实现显着的预测性能，这就提出了显式键合概念是否仍有必要的问题。在这项工作中，我们认为人工智能并没有使化学键合过时，而是为评估和完善键合概念提供了一个新的框架。我们表明，通过线性探测， Allegro和MACE嵌入恢复与（ R ² > 0.95 ）的键合描述符，表明键合自然地从Allegro和MACE的潜在空间中出现。

arXiv:2511.18512v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study neural-network approximation of density functionals in a Banach-space setting. For energies obtained by minimization over compact density sets, we account exactly for the energy shift caused by regularization and bound the remaining error by the localization on these compact sets and network approximation errors. item.title: PLUMED-JAX: GPU-native enhanced sampling for atomistic simulations
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Venkat Kapil
arXiv:2611.00483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present PLUMED-JAX, an AI-assisted adaptation of selected PLUMED collective variables, umbrella sampling, and metadynamics for JAX-based atomistic simulations, developed using gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning effort set to high within the Codex harness. Integration with JAX-MD supports compiled molecular dynamics, batched replicas, walkers sharing a bias, and execution across multiple graphics processing units. We validate the framework against PLUMED and exact free energy benchmarks, and demonstrate applications to butane, silicon crystallization, and lithium transport, with severalfold improvements in computational throughput for both classical forcefields and machine learning interatomic potentials.
